title: Bolus percentage improvements in bolus wizard, and quickwizard
symptom: The bolus wizard lacks flexibility in applying a percentage to the bolus result, making it difficult to manage corrections and pre-boluses. The user must manually calculate and deliver pre-boluses using multiple buttons, and there is no way to customize bolus percentage per quickwizard button.
fix: The feature was implemented in a later commit, but the thread does not describe the specific implementation details.
